subject: Data Engineering
title: Google BigQuery's Approach
description: A quick win: understand Google BigQuery's Approach.

hook.text: BigQuery is serverless. There's no cluster to configure, no infrastructure to manage. Just SQL.

buildup.text: Google built BigQuery on Dremel, their internal engine for querying petabytes interactively.

discovery.text: BigQuery charges per query based on data scanned, not compute time — a unique pricing model.

twist.text: A poorly written query that scans everything can cost hundreds of dollars in seconds.

climax.text: BigQuery's serverless model is ideal for unpredictable workloads where you can't size clusters ahead.

punchline.text: No servers. Just SQL and a bill per query.

quiz.question: How does BigQuery primarily charge for queries?
options: Based on the amount of data scanned
